Objects re-exported from MiscMetabar

Source: R/align_pq.R
reexports.Rd

align_pq() and is_mafft_installed() were introduced in phylopq 0.2.0 and now live in MiscMetabar, so that every package of the pqverse can reach the MAFFT backend without depending on phylopq — MiscMetabar must keep working on its own, so it cannot depend on phylopq, and it is the one package the others already share.

They are re-exported here, so phylopq::align_pq() and phylopq::is_mafft_installed() keep working unchanged. The only visible difference is the option that holds the path to the executable, renamed from phylopq.mafftpath to MiscMetabar.mafftpath.

See also

MiscMetabar::align_pq(), MiscMetabar::is_mafft_installed(), delim_pq(), delim_multi_pq()
